title: Brian Donohue
subtitle: Hi, I’m Brian. I’m originally from Fort Lee NJ, of Chris Christie Bridgegate fame, and spent several years living in Brooklyn NY before moving to Oakland CA. I went to college at a small, private technology school in Hoboken NJ called Stevens Institute of Technology, where I majored in Computer Science and graduated with High Honors.
